items.title: Jimmie "Kid" Clayton Interview
items.q: I made her raise the price. So she raised the price and I played for until she gave the place up.

ctx.x: Yeah. Are there any other jobs you can remember? Well, I know you played hundreds and hundreds of places, I'm not going to try to make you remember all of it. Any longer engagements, any particular place?

Well, the longer engagements, let me see, I was at the Humming Boy and then out at Mamalu. But after I went to the army and come back I went out there and worked. And the time we was working out there, before the war, we was getting about two and a half a man out of tips. But the tips was great. Each man would make around about fifty, sixty, seventy an hour. Besides that little two and a half a night it paid. But after I come out the army I wouldn't play for that no more. I made her raise the price. So she raised…
How many years were you there altogether?
